args.title: Fix currency symbol parsing in `parseAmount` function
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

The `parseAmount` function did not account for the rupee (₹) and Swiss franc (CHF) currency symbols, causing import failures. The function needs adjustment to include these symbols to ensure seamless import of files with these currency signs.

label: bug
file: src/util/money.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The issue is due to the `parseAmount` function not handling the rupee (₹) and CHF currency symbols. Adjusting this function to recognize these currency symbols should solve the problem. A draft PR is proposed for changes in `src/util/money.ts` to include these symbols.
